leadStory: Bournemouth 0-1 Liverpool: Alexander Isak turns in a blocked Cody Gakpo cross on 57 minutes for a third consecutive Premier League clean sheet, lifting Liverpool from tenth to sixth and making Andoni Iraola the first manager unbeaten in his opening five league games in charge of Liverpool since Joe Fagan in 1983.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The decisive moment was a six-yard tap-in from a deflected block, which does not resolve into a single strong still, and the skill caps queueing at one genuinely visual moment per edition. Antigravity should take no action. If a plate is wanted for a future edition, the standing candidate is Jeremy Jacquet, 21, the best player on the field on the day France called him up for the first time.
